title: 第23章 镇妖碑前折木剑无缘藏书阁第24章 众里寻书惹人笑不知少年藏鸿鹄
content_zh:
“这是什么？”
陆晨吓得面色苍白，本能的后退。
数百年来，青云门不止一次出现过类似的妖族入侵，他以为是强大的妖族突然降临了呢。
“肃静！”
玄机子看着不少吓得后退的人，面色一沉。
只见玄机子手掌一抬，掌心之中，有一道浩然之气光团涌现，那一道浩然之气攀上头顶，悬停在镇妖碑上，镇妖碑赋予那一道浩然之气英灵之气，化作一缕缕芒光，芒光精准飞向演武场的每一个弟子。
噗通。
噗通！
顾余生身边，包括陆晨在内的数人，好似突然被一股沉重的力量压在肩头，双膝跪地，身体再也站不起来。
玄机子肃然道：“刚才后退的弟子，失去进入藏书阁的资格，你们只准去凌霄峰的藏经阁选取功法，滚吧！”
说罢，袖子一拂，那些跪倒在地的人，这才如释重负般恢复了自由之身。
“等等，掌门！”
陆展看见自己的儿子陆晨跪在地上，脸色变得难看至极。
“不用多说！”
玄机子手持掌门令，身上的气息与往日截然不同，说话间也夹杂着威严。
“其他弟子，立即进入藏书阁挑选一门功法，能挑选到什么功法，看你们自己的造化，其余之事，不许多问多想。”
“是！”
众多弟子闻言狂喜，也有人暗自庆幸刚才没有胆怯。
这藏书阁看起来极其神秘，显然不属于青云门。
如今机缘就在眼前，谁都不想错过。

“不！”
陆晨一脸不甘。
“掌门，我没有后退！”
“是啊，我也没有后退！”
那些刚才跪下，身上被打上镇妖碑英灵印记的人，一脸不甘的诉说着冤屈。
人人都知道，镇妖碑凝聚了无数英魂的热血，不会撒谎。
玄机子一脸冷漠，指着那镇妖碑前乌龟背上的剑，厉声喝道：
“住口，都给转身，看看那一把剑，那就是遇见妖族而不敢拔剑只顾逃跑的懦夫留下的剑，那一把耻辱之剑你们天天都见到，难道还没有让你们长记性吗？记住，顾白这个名字，就是懦夫的代号！”
玄机子说到这，似想起什么，目光逡巡，在那些后退的人群中扫过，眉头微微一皱，收回目光，最终落在那棵老槐树下的少年身上。
顾余生站在那，与其他人格格不入，而很多人的目光，也同样在看着顾余生，似乎有些诧异他没有退后。
玄机子神色莫名，他上前一步，当着所有人的面，对形单影只的少年道：“顾余生，那乌龟背上的耻辱之剑，你可曾记住？”
藏书阁就在眼前，很多人巴不得早点进去，可掌门的威严，以及突然提及顾余生，让很多青云门弟子脸上都露出几分思索。
掌门这是要立威吗？
面对所有人的目光，顾余生并没有回答玄机子的提问，而是淡淡的说道：
“顾白，我的父亲，他不是懦夫，当他知道外面有大妖，依旧义无反顾走出青云门面对的时候，他就已经是英雄了，他的名字，应该在镇妖碑上，他的剑，是守护之剑！”
听见顾余生的话，很多人都在嘲笑。
玄机子也表情冷然，沉声道：“哦？你的意思是，我们这么做错了？”
content_en:
"What is this?"
Lu Chen turned pale with fright and instinctively retreated.
Over the past hundreds of years, Qingyun Sect had experienced similar demonic invasions more than once. He thought that a powerful demonic clan had suddenly arrived.
"Quiet!"
Xuanjizi's face darkened as he looked at the many people who were so frightened that they backed away.
I saw Xuanjizi raised his hand, and in the palm of his hand, a ball of awe-inspiring aura emerged. That aura of awe-inspiring energy climbed above his head and hovered on the demon-suppressing stele. The demon-suppressing stele gave that aura of awe-inspiring aura and heroic spirit, turned into wisps of light, and the light flew accurately towards every disciple in the martial arts field.
Plop.
Plop!
Several people around Gu Yusheng, including Lu Chen, seemed to be suddenly pressed by a heavy force on their shoulders. They fell to their knees and could no longer stand up.
Xuanjizi said solemnly: "The disciples who retreated just now are disqualified from entering the Library Pavilion. You are only allowed to go to the Library Pavilion in Lingxiao Peak to select the exercises. Get out!"
After that, with a flick of their sleeves, those who had knelt on the ground regained their freedom as if they were relieved.
"Wait, Master!"
Lu Zhan saw his son Lu Chen kneeling on the ground, his expression turned extremely ugly.
"No need to say more!"
Xuanjizi held the leader's order, his aura was completely different from the past, and his words were also mixed with majesty.
"Other disciples, immediately enter the library and choose a technique. Which technique you can choose depends on your own destiny. For the rest, don't ask too much and think too much."
"Yes!"
Many disciples were overjoyed when they heard this, and some were secretly glad that they were not timid just now.
This library looks extremely mysterious and obviously does not belong to Qingyun Sect.
Now that the opportunity is right in front of you, no one wants to miss it.
"No!"
Lu Chen looked unwilling.
"Master, I didn't retreat!"
"Yeah, I didn't retreat either!"
Those who had just knelt down and whose bodies were marked with the heroic spirit mark of the Demon Suppressing Monument expressed their grievances with unwilling expressions.
Everyone knows that the Demon Suppressing Monument has condensed the blood of countless heroic souls and cannot lie.
Xuanjizi looked indifferent, pointed at the sword on the turtle's back in front of the demon-suppressing monument, and shouted sternly:
"Stop, turn around and look at that sword. It is the sword left by the coward who did not dare to draw his sword when he encountered the demon clan and just ran away. You see that sword of shame every day. Hasn't it made you remember it? Remember, the name Gu Bai is the code name of a coward!"
When Xuanjizi said this, he seemed to think of something. His eyes wandered across the retreating crowd, his brows furrowed slightly, and he retracted his gaze, finally landing on the young man under the old locust tree.
Gu Yusheng stood there, out of tune with the others, and many people's eyes were also looking at Gu Yusheng, seeming a little surprised that he didn't step back.
Xuan Jizi looked confused. He took a step forward and said to the lonely young man in front of everyone: "Gu Yusheng, have you ever remembered the sword of shame on the turtle's back?"
The Library Pavilion was right in front of them, and many people were eager to go in as soon as possible, but the majesty of the leader and the sudden mention of Gu Yusheng made many Qingyun Sect disciples look thoughtful.
Is the leader trying to establish his authority?
Facing everyone's gaze, Gu Yusheng did not answer Xuanjizi's question, but said calmly:
"Gu Bai, my father, he is not a coward. When he knew that there was a big monster outside and still walked out of Qingyun Gate to face it without hesitation, he was already a hero. His name should be on the monster-suppressing monument, and his sword is the sword of protection!"
Many people laughed at Gu Yusheng's words.
Xuanjizi also had a cold expression and said in a deep voice: "Oh? You mean, what we did was wrong?"
